test.create_query: CREATE TABLE array_lc_filter (k UInt64, arr Array(LowCardinality(String))) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO array_lc_filter SELECT number, arrayMap(x -> toString((number + x) % 1000), range(number % 10)) FROM numbers(20000000)
test.query: SELECT arr FROM array_lc_filter PREWHERE k % 2 = 0 FORMAT Null
SELECT arr FROM array_lc_filter WHERE k % 2 = 0 SETTINGS optimize_move_to_prewhere = 0 FORMAT Null
